title: LADA Y vs T.B.D., Nov 9
notes: Away game at Snoqualmie A: we wore light blue and had the right bench; T.B.D. wore white with teal and green trim, a few of them in green. The 68-minute wide cut (uploaded Nov 17) came at the rink's usual 3840x1536. The game sheet (SportNinja, read through its public API) gave the score, the goals, the penalties, the shots and who played; the arena scoreboard and the video confirmed every goal.

Periods by the scoreboard clock (we were GUEST): 0:02-18:04, 19:59-38:19 and 40:09-68:36 of the video. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd. The video runs to the final horn. Final 4-3, shots 24-42 (4-12, 10-10, 10-20), from the sheet.

Goals, each found by eye and matched to the board's clock: ours at 1:12 (Fisenko from Bronnikov), 10:03 (Ber on a 2-on-0), 31:00 (Fisenko, shorthanded) and 48:12 (Fisenko at 4 on 4, his hat trick); theirs at 15:08 (#21 Schiller, in a scramble with our goalie down), 32:10 (#91 Muratidinov from #48) and 60:31 (#91 again, shorthanded against our power play). The board posted the 4-2 goal only at 49:57, during play.

Penalties: Barkov #97 tripping in the 2nd, 3:00 on the board though the sheet says a 2-minute minor (kill 27:58-31:38 of the video, Fisenko's shorthanded goal inside it), and holding in the 3rd (kill 47:04-50:32, 4 on 4 until their #91's roughing ran out at 49:40). Yafunyaev #29 and their #17 (served by #61) took coincident roughing minors at 9:09 of the 3rd: no panel lit, each sat 2:00 in his box (#29 until 57:30), and both teams played 5 on 5, so #29 is off the ice there but it isn't a penalty kill.

Eleven skaters and Hilfer #31 in goal. Subs: Fisenko #58 (Turbo Kings' goalie, a forward here) and Bronnikov #74. Absent: Sokolov #4, Belousenko #11 and #13, Kondratenko #12, Unuchek #49, Beregovoy #67/#87, Lisitsyn #70, Shakhov #78 and Olyanich #89. The 285 reads of '27' were Akulov #37 and the 215 reads of '4' were Ber #14 and Bronnikov #74.

The lineup was checked by eye at every window the solver flagged: 70 on/off spans, most for players seated on our bench (by the camera) whom the tracker had on the ice. Six were set by hand from frames: #82 on and #29 off for the 15:08 goal (#82 at our net at 15:06), #82 off at the end of the 2nd-period kill (seated at 31:25-31:56), #14 on and #29 off around the 32:10 goal, and #29 off while he sat in the box. Lisitsyn #32's low ice time is real: he sat long stretches (in the 1st, on only at 3:19-5:03, 8:51-10:20 and 14:21-15:19).
